description: Index of Industrial Production, manufacturing and its 23 NIC 2-digit divisions, 2022-23 base: latest month y/y as published by MoSPI; the latest three months (m3, 3mma) and the calendar year to date (January to the latest month) against the same months a year earlier, calculated by Asia Decoded as ratios of summed indices. Also two groups calculated at MoSPI's 2022-23 weights: electronics and electrical (NIC 26, 27) and non-electronics (the other 21 divisions). Built by the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (data/in/iip/in_iip_divisions.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each monthly IIP release by a scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals.
title: India IIP by industry (MoSPI)
